The dual-engine thesis

Project KJ runs on two engines built to compound each other. Commerce brings density; the mesh turns that density into sovereign infrastructure. Every deployment strengthens both.

LIVE · v0.7
ENGINE 01

KrobJob

Commerce OS

A commission-free commerce platform for Thai restaurants — point of sale, Thai VAT & tax compliance, PromptPay direct payments, and a new path to privacy-first operations intelligence. Monetization rails are built and pre-revenue by design; premium Ground add-ons enter controlled pilot validation next.

POSThai VAT / TaxPromptPayCommission-free

ENGINE 02

Krobjob Grid

Sovereign Mesh

An off-grid 920–925 MHz LoRa mesh — developed: resilient, independent connectivity that does not rely on carrier networks. Built so each commerce site becomes a node in a wider sovereign fabric; wide-scale deployment is the next step.

LoRa 920–925 MHzOff-gridMesh nodesSovereign

Every KrobJob merchant is a future Grid node. Every Grid deployment is a KrobJob distribution channel.

$1.0M on hardware success.

We’re at the door. Pre-pilot testing is underway, and the pilot is ordered the moment the hardware gate clears.

  • 01Asset-based, never an ARR multiple. We're pre-revenue (≈฿0) on purpose — the valuation rests on shipped software, mesh IP, the licensed e-wallet rail and the data loop. No projected-revenue arithmetic.
  • 02The value is already here — merged and bankable. Through the merger with the Thai company holding the e-wallet licence (Group-1), what exists today supports ≈$480K of bank-loan-grade value (computed floor ≈$326–407K). And the bet is risk-adjusted: pilot equipment resells at ~50% after we take what we need — unless everything fails, value remains.
  • 03Hardware and pilot proof → $1.0M target valuation. Clearing the hardware gate and proving the concept in the field support the $1.0M step inside our internally modeled $1–3M band. The re-rate is earned by measured results, not assumed in advance.
  • 04Three stages. Each one must earn the next. Stage 1: $15K proves the concept with the first pilot. Stage 2: $62K funds the planned Udon Thani-wide expansion after the pilot works. Stage 3: up to $240K prepares the regulated token launch and Bangkok rollout after the expansion reaches its milestones.

$15K → prove it. Then $62K → expand across Udon Thani. Only after those milestones: up to $240K → token-launch preparation and Bangkok.

Funder advantage stack

Keep the key. Keep the advantages.

The Funder Key sits above every merchant tier—from KJ Local and KJ Pioneer through KJ Vanguard, KJ Genesis, and KJ Global. It does not replace a merchant tier; it upgrades the holder’s eligible position as each program comes online.

Core utilityOWNERSHIP-VERIFIED

  • 1.5× node-yield multiplierOnce node rewards launch, the eligible holder receives a 1.5× multiplier above their active merchant tier.
  • Zero KJ platform commissionEligible KrobJob inventory, campaign, and token-routing fees are waived while the key is held; taxes, logistics, network gas, and third-party charges remain separate.
  • One free Merchant Mystery Box claimOne claim or guaranteed allocation per Funder Key, recorded against its token ID to prevent double-claiming.
  • Founder VaultA dedicated holographic slot in the internal wallet with milestone-by-milestone utility decryption.

Milestone unlocksTERMS · SYSTEMS · LEGAL

  • 5% collective Funder poolFunders collectively share 5% of eligible Merchant Mystery Box mint revenue and node upgrade fees after the legal, accounting, eligibility, and payout rules activate.
  • 2× Merchant Box luck boostTwice the published odds of revealing KJ Genesis or KJ Global, with every eligible Funder Box guaranteed to reveal KJ Pioneer or higher under independently testable rules.
  • First-wave IOTA hardware priorityPriority access to pilot beacon/sensor development kits; shipping geography, duties, and availability require published terms.
  • Sovereign protocol keyGovernance and protocol utility stays classified until the required network milestone is live and documented.
4 PHASESSeed Pool → Merchant Launch → IOTA Hardware → Sovereign Protocol. The wallet reveals only the utility that is operational; unreleased benefits remain visibly locked.

Project KJ design principle

We're not minting a promise — we're building the infrastructure of the internet itself: a sovereign mesh where every merchant becomes a node, and a live testbed for how token‑incentivized physical networks actually work.

Private by design · Thai by design

Anonymous‑first. Data stays in Thailand.

Sovereignty isn't just the mesh — it's how this whole thing handles you and your data.

0
Silent external calls. Fonts and artwork are local; there are no analytics, trackers or automatic wallet requests. Chain access begins only after the user explicitly connects a browser wallet.
User-authorized wallet access only
Anon‑first
No PII forms. Interest and claiming are designed wallet‑first and pseudonymous; identity only where the law requires it (KYC thresholds under legal review).
Design principle — final mechanics pending legal review
🇹🇭 In‑country
Data residency: Thailand. PromptPay is a domestic rail; the LoRa mesh is sovereign, carrier‑independent infrastructure; processing is planned in‑territory. PDPA‑alignment by design.
Design principle — formal PDPA review pending

Even the typeface is Thai — Chakra Petch, by a Bangkok foundry, embedded in the page. No font CDN. No silent phone‑home.
